title: Huang Is Worth Up to $10 Trillion to the Market, Ives Says
description: Dan Ives, senior managing director at Yorkville Ives & Co., discusses Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer and his value to the AI growth cycle and overall market. "We continue to be bullish, not just on Nvidia, but the overall tech trade," Ives tells Bloomberg Television. "AI is not stopping here despite maybe scarcity of capital," he adds. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: HSBC's Kettner Says VIX at 30 Is Long-Term Buying Opportunity
description: Max Kettner, chief multi-asset strategist at HSBC Bank, discusses the selloff in stocks, the impact of Federal Reserve policy on market sentiment, and why he sees long-term opportunities to invest in equities despite the current market turmoil. "Do you sell equities at a VIX of 30? No. You do the opposite. You buy it," Kettner tells Bloomberg Television. The Cboe Volatility Index (VIX) is the stock market’s main volatility gauge. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple Watch, Oura Ring, iPhone Duo: Best Tech Gifts for Holiday 2026
description: With holiday shopping now in full swing, many consumers are being bombarded with the “best deals” for devices and gadgets they might have little need for, and it’s all too easy to be lured into impulse purchases. Black Friday and the trove of other discounts landing over the next few weeks are often an excellent opportunity to buy products like wireless headphones, a bigger and brighter TV or perhaps even a new smartphone.
